regime_context: US thematic leadership is broad (73% of themes eligible, no single narrative dominant), led by Memory/HBM/Storage with Silver Miners as a clear but not decisive challenger. Momentum rank is a focus lens only (track record dir_accuracy 0.368 on n=38 — near coin-flip on direction), so this note expresses fallible leans, not edge extracted from the detector. Absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg (vol/drawdown control), and it IS helping historically on this market.
emerging_watch: Watching Silver Miners (SIL) as a confirmed-handoff candidate: if its momentum score closes the 1.035 gap to Memory/HBM/Storage AND its durability_bar holds above 0.70 while breadth stays at 1.0 for five consecutive sessions, that retires the watch as a leadership change; if SIL's score rolls over and falls back below Gold Miners (score ~1.8) within the same window, the watch ends with no handoff.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are one of the few themes with coherent trend-health support: breadth 1.0, durability bar 0.84, and the only clean 'trend' Hurst tag among the top ranks. Unlike the momentum leader (Memory), which has breadth 0.0 and a low durability bar, Gold Miners show participation across the basket — the staying-power leg the detector actually validates for drawdown control.
theses.dissent: Gold miners have already enjoyed a strong run and precious metals are sensitive to a sudden real-rates spike; the momentum score is still well behind the leader, suggesting relative interest may be waning rather than building.

falsifier.text: GDX falls below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 10 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW combines the strongest durability profile among defensive-leaning themes (bar 0.75), a 'trend' Hurst tag, and broad participation (breadth 0.864) with a positive momentum score. It sits in the crowded zone (z 1.53), which is a size-down caution, not a fade — so the direction is constructive but humility on magnitude is required.
theses.dissent: Crowding at 1.53 is the highest in the defensives complex and near the top of the board; this is often where reflexive reversals start, and a crowded trend can unwind faster than it built.

falsifier.text: XLV underperforms the S&P 500 by 4% over a rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity shows the same trend/durability strengths as the healthcare complex (bar 0.78, 'trend' tag, breadth 0.6) but carries the single most extreme crowding_z on the entire board at 1.57. Under the detector's own guardrails, crowding is a down-size signal — an 'avoid' lean reflects prudence around reflexivity risk, not a bearish call.
evidence: crowding_z 1.57, crowded=true — highest on the board
theses.dissent: The trend is intact and breadth is healthy; crowding alone has no validated basket-level forward edge, so avoiding it may simply mean missing continued participation in a durable flow.

falsifier.text: CIBR's crowding_z drops back below 1.0 while its momentum score stays above 0.5 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
